Women 30–55 noticing changes in desire, sensitivity or comfort.

**Audience (`product.json`, the dealer's default):** women only: the image question never asks men or women; the dealer casts women and refuses `--audience men`.

## What it is (bible, one line)
Modern women’s intimacy support focused on desire, sensitivity, comfort, and responsiveness.

- Keep it tasteful — product imagery led, no bedroom scenes.
- Color: pinks, tans and warm neutrals, plus more white and teal — white backgrounds for advertorials. See page 4.

## Headlines: references, not limits

No tiers, no per-line approvals (Mitansh 2026-11-05).

## Hard stops (this product)
- Lines the screening table marks ❌ / Hard NO conflict: never. Everything that is not a Hard NO is wording, and wording is free.
- Lovara is women's intimacy support (desire, sensitivity, comfort, responsiveness). No "ED", "erectile", "performance",
  "Viagra", "instant", no timing promises ("tonight", "in 30 min"), no guarantees, no explicit sexual wording, never "Spark".
- Ingredient names appear only inside their own approved claim (F4/F9 rows), never as a product promise; the ingredient list is under
  review (Justin), so prefer product-level "Supports…" lines until it's confirmed.
- **No beds or bedroom scenes**, no lingerie, no body shots, no lips macro, no generic stock-style couples (bible), no before/after. A woman is clothed, candid,
  30–55, shoulder-up or waist-up, daytime (kitchen, café, terrace, garden, studio, bathroom counter), an ordinary non-famous face,
  a different woman in every ad.
- Never a strength, dose or count. No needles, syringes or vials.
- No "Are you/Do you…?" questions, no first person, no named competitors, no "clinically studied" for the product.
- Images: the name "LOVARA" big, never "by Everlife". Proof wording exact; disclaimer verbatim (the finisher adds both).

## Offer, CTAs and claims (from the bible, version 1793912918-b19b; generated, never edit)
- **Offer:** "Save Up to 45%" is the product's highest discount (bible rule 09; source: CTA). It is the default CTA. Always "Save Up to N%", never a fixed discount, never another product's %.
- **Default CTA:** "Save Up to 45%". **All bible CTAs:** "Explore Lovara" · "Support Your Spark" · "Save Up to 45%" · "Discover Lovara" · "Lovara for $1.75/day" · "Ships Free From Pharmacy". The gate refuses any other CTA string.
- **Price CTA (approved alternative; the only $ amount allowed):** "Lovara for $1.75/day".
- **Quick-hit benefits (word for word, the only benefit lines):** Supports Desire + Sensitivity · Promotes Comfort + Responsiveness · Supports Intimate Readiness · Promotes Healthy Circulation · 3-in-1 Intimacy Support · Modern Intimacy Support · Encourages Desire in Mind + Body · Supports Pleasure + Sensitivity.
- **More approved benefits:** Feel More Connected · Enhances Sensitivity.
- **Product Hard NOs (bible):** Never use “arousal” or any form of it (“aroused,” “arousing”). · Plus all global Hard NOs on page 3.
- **Retired, never use (left the bible or banned):** Get Started Now · Start Your Plan.
- **Disclaimer:** verbatim in `product.json` (= the bible's); the finisher lays it. Exact strings for pasting: `python3 core/scripts/product_copy.py <id>`.
